notes.title: "Duelist's Resolve" Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Duelists! We’re thrilled to roll out the "Duelist’s Resolve" update, packed with critical fixes, balancing tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:[/h3]

[h3]Multiplayer Stability & Fair Play[/h3]
Duel Integrity: If a player quits/disconnects mid-duel, the duel is immediately revoked. The opponent gracefully exits the ring and respawns as a ghost—no more unfair losses!

Host Migration: When the host disconnects, the server/lobby now seamlessly transfers to another player. Applies to party games only. Say goodbye to dropped sessions!

[h3]Combat & Ability Balancing[/h3]
Lunge Tweak: Post-lunge movement is now slowed by 80% until stamina regenerates past 50%. Use this ability strategically—reckless charges have consequences!

Lock-On Smoothing: Camera tracking now feels buttery-smooth during intense clashes. Never lose sight of your foe!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Tutorial Ground Collider: Fixed the "falling through the world" bug in tutorial!

PvE Weapon Clashing: Weapon weight simulation now accurately affects both hands during clashes. Heavier weapons = more impactful staggers!

[h3]Map & Scene Optimization[/h3]
Throne Map Separation: The Throne map is now a dedicated scene, decoupled from the Title Menu. Expect faster loads and smoother transitions!

notes.title: December Update - Character Overhual
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Duelist’s, This is Community Manager Tyrus Rechs.  I would like to introduce you to our final feature update before launch. This update is to overhaul the sword and player avatar physics. 

We have added an advanced body physics panel in the lobby to add a toggle for advance foot work. As well as advanced upper body muscles. We have received complaints from our testers that these features 'might' cause motion sickness, so they are off by default. However these advanced body physics gives you greater control over your avatar. 

However having these features toggled on will not give you any advantage over your opponent but they will make the avatar respond in a more martial art style, and easier to control.

Next update will be bug fixes and UI fixes to prepare for launch on December 31st. 
[/h3]

notes.title: PARTY ROOM UPDATE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FIDn3dLuTl0;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]To celebrate the launch of this update we will be putting the game on sale for 30% off for the next 7 days.[/h1]

CHANGE LOG FOR PARTY ROOM UPDATE

Featured addition to the game: 

The gamemode "party lobby"
1. Select Warrior
2. Select Armour and Weapon Set of the Selected Warrior
3. Join Match Queue List
4. Bet
5. Players fight
6. Winning duelist claims all bets (gold) of the opponent's table, spectators will either win or loose money depending on who they choose to bet on.

Added Revoke Duel button in Bet Table. Menu to vote for revoking active duel. All player's not in duel are required to vote. Once revoked all bets (gold)on the table will be returned.
Game will automatically revoke active duel if one or more duelists are not spawned correctly. 

Hitting opponent's sword on weak position with strong position of your own sword will fatigue opponent's arm, and push his sword away. He needs a couple seconds to recover, which leaves you a great opportunity for offensive moves. New physics works for client vs client duels in the party lobby.

Replaced OST 

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the effort required to trigger dismemberment.

[*] Players in PvP now cannot be grabbed while riding horse

[*] Change the concept of size equality to adjust character model to fit into player's vr rig (player' real life size). This will eliminate the player's false limb size. 

[*] Tweaked muscle strength to have better results of weapon impact.

[*] Players now can strike opponent' weapon on it's weak position to make opponent' weapon and arm move away to create opening for follow-up attack.

[*] Blocking in a strong position will not be affected.  Tweaked armed combat feedback to make it more realistic and playable.

[*] Improved hand to hand combat Physic. Every punch has more weight sensation, and can be blocked or deflected more easily, including PVP. Added damage bonus for elbow attack

[/list]
[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed messenger error in Way of Duelist home menu, portal will spawn correctly.

[*] Fixed the bug, Player still standing after leg being cut off.

[*] Fixed the bug, Player killed on horse in PvP will get launched into air.

[*] Fixed the bug, weapon following player in home lobby.

[*] Fixed the bug, that demo could be turned - into a full game by replacing data folder.

[*] Fixed drifting issue for samurai.

[*] Disabled torso dismemberment 

[*] Fixed the bug, Client Rematch button not working

[*] Fixed the bug, punch sound effects can't be played.

[*] Fixed the bug in Demo PvP that game crash upon grabbing weapon.

[*] Fixed the bug, blood spill effects do not play when damaged by weapon

[/list]
[b]Networking and coding [/b]
Rewritten the codes for loading weapons in PvP, to fix the issue that client player sometimes had no weapon spawned due to lagging during game loading. 

Improved and optimized weapon netcodes to support more than 2 players connected with no performance impact on host player.

Refined algorithm for weapon clash feedback force.

notes.title: Blood & Gore Update for both PvP and PvE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215675/2b07ba2d0c681f3278aa6acdee23127e8c4230e9.gif[/img]
Hello this is Tyrus.
Community Manager for Death Duel VR. I'm here to announce our latest update for DDVR which will bring more blood, gore, and dismemberment to the game. This feature will make fighting more realistic. As a playtester put it,
"It feels like I'm wieldling a dangerous weapon now!"

Our developer Doglord has been working hard on other things as well, such as vastly improved tracking and calibration, and a whole host of bug fixes and netcode improvements. 

We also promised a little suprise in the road-map last update. We had to delay it to make certain we could do it. So without further ado, it's time for the suprise announcement you have been waiting for...

We have begun work on: DEDICATED SERVERS which in turn will lead to 🥁 🥁 🥁 QUEST COMPATIBILITY BY Q1 2025!!! 🥳 Suprise! 

Remember always be ... En garde

Sincerely,
Tyrus Rechs 
Change log for dismemberment update:

We have fixed In-game voice communication. 

We have listened and heard your complaints about the calibration. Camera position, arm length and hand tracking is now been greatly improved. 

We have increased damage for hand to hand combat to make Boxing feel more aggressive.

We have fixed the Lock-On system that was added to Fight Stance Mode last update. Lock-on will now work in multiplayer.

We have improved weapon pick-up system to make it absolutely smooth to pick up a weapon in both local and online gameplay.

We have overhauled the netcode and improved it for multiplayer to increase the smoothness of PVP gameplay.

We noticed some complaints about grabbing enemies, thus we have simplified grab mechanics of enemy/players (just pull the trigger to grab).

Main feature:
The dismemberment feature is now here. You can cut off legs, feet, hands, arms, and heads, this is now available for both PVE and PVP gameplay.
